issues.on_page: Nonoperating: Loss on disposal of assets (3,808)
issues.issue: A nonoperating loss on disposal is recorded as other_financing, not as a spending line. The roll-forward still holds, and this matches FY2024, but it is not a financing flow (Scottsbluff FY2024 kept such a loss in nonoperating as Loss on Disposal of Assets).
Cemetery spending is normally health/welfare. The extractor followed the p5 statement, which counts General Fund 265 under Public works. Judgment call.
The page does not say these are ambulance fees, only Fire/Rescue charges for services (Statement of Activities: Public safety charges 2,376). Probably correct, but it is an assumption.
